WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.TITLE: Meta templates
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.HELP: Create a text template for Meta review. This does not send messages to contacts. Only positional variables in the body are supported. Media, authentication and carousel templates must be managed in Meta.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.NAME: Name (lowercase letters, digits and underscores)
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.VARIABLE_HELP: Use numbered variables starting at 1, without gaps; provide an example for each.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.EMPTY: No cached templates. Synchronize to check Meta.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.CREATED: Template {name}. Meta status: {status}. Creation does not imply approval.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_CREATION.UNCERTAIN: The result is uncertain. Do not submit again: a template may already exist in Meta. Synchronize explicitly or check Meta Manager. Sending remains blocked until synchronization finds the same name, language and content.

VALIDATION.NAME: Use 1–512 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
VALIDATION.BODY: Enter a body with at most 1,024 characters.
VALIDATION.VARIABLES: Use only positional variables in sequence, starting at 1, without gaps or malformed braces.
VALIDATION.EXAMPLES: Provide a nonempty example for every variable.
VALIDATION.HEADER: Header: at most 60 characters, without variables.
VALIDATION.FOOTER: Footer: at most 60 characters, without variables.
VALIDATION.BUTTONS: Use up to 3 quick replies OR 2 static HTTPS links. Labels are required (25 characters maximum); variables are not supported.

ERRORS.permission_denied: Meta did not authorize this operation. Check whatsapp_business_management permission and access to the WhatsApp account. Your draft is preserved.
ERRORS.authentication_required: The Meta credential is invalid or expired. Reauthorize the inbox. Your draft is preserved.
ERRORS.access_denied: Check your session and sign in as an administrator of this account to manage templates. Your draft is preserved.
ERRORS.validation_failed: The template failed server validation. Review the fields and examples. Your draft is preserved.
ERRORS.provider_rejected: Meta rejected this request. Review the content and configuration in Meta Manager. Your draft is preserved.
ERRORS.temporarily_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. No automatic retry was made. Your draft is preserved.
ERRORS.outcome_unknown: The creation result could not be confirmed. Check synchronization and Meta before any retry.
ERRORS.configuration_missing: The official WhatsApp inbox configuration is incomplete.
ERRORS.name_conflict: A template with this name and language already exists with different content. Choose another name or review it in Meta.
ERRORS.unsupported_provider: Template creation is only supported for official WhatsApp Cloud API inboxes.
ERRORS.load_failed: Could not load cached templates. Your draft is preserved.
